canonical_scene_pose.description: Authored illustration shows retained cartridge on dock; reset static fixture starts undocked. These are separate named states, not hardware readbacks.

sample_switch_gate: A docked cartridge is required for CLAMP, VERIFY_CLAMP and SWITCH_SAMPLE. Undocking invalidates any pending observation. Every successful switch consumes its independent clamp observation. A new CLAMP and VERIFY_CLAMP cycle is required before every subsequent switch; re-verification alone cannot reuse a consumed cycle.
